name: raptor_trinity_candidate_panel
note: Deterministic local stress panel. This is not the final frozen public Trinity parity panel.

fixtures.name: tiny_alt_isoform
fixtures.description: Two related isoforms with shared terminal exons and one alternative exon.

fixtures.name: ambiguous_paralog
fixtures.description: Ambiguous isoform/paralog fixture that rejects partial false-positive isoforms.

fixtures.name: compact_fusion
fixtures.description: Overlapping-transcript fusion-control fixture that requires paired-start evidence.

fixtures.name: antisense_overlap
fixtures.description: Opposite-strand transcript pair with reverse-complement overlap that requires strand-aware RF handling.

fixtures.name: partial_antisense_overlap
fixtures.description: Transcript pair with only the middle segment in antisense orientation, stressing strand-aware overlap partitioning.

fixtures.name: high_depth_normalization
fixtures.description: High-depth single-transcript fixture for forcing normalization to reduce paired reads.
